# Security Policy

The Raz project takes security issues seriously.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public GitHub issue for suspected security vulnerabilities.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature on the affected repository when it is available. If private reporting is not enabled, contact the maintainers privately before publishing technical details.

A useful report includes:

- affected repository and revision or release;
- affected platform or target;
- concise reproduction steps;
- expected and observed behavior;
- security impact;
- proof-of-concept material when appropriate;
- suggested remediation, if known.

Please allow maintainers reasonable time to investigate and prepare a fix before public disclosure.

## Scope

Security reports may include issues in the compiler, runtime, package tooling, standard library, generated code, parsers, package metadata handling, build tooling, and official infrastructure.

Normal correctness bugs without a security impact should be reported through the standard issue tracker.
